name: Guild Street
desc1: This is a cobblestoned street. It is dimly lit by guttering lanterns
desc2: hung from tall posts, and continues to the north and south. Off to the
desc3: south, you can see the Adventurer's Guild rising up over the tops of
desc4: of the surrounding buildings. To the west, a strange ramshackle
desc5: booth stands, a wooden sign posted to its side reading "Trader Tull's
